# Muddy York Fishing

> Muddy York Fishing is an app for Southern Ontario trout, steelhead and salmon anglers. Each morning it ranks 30+ rivers on live water temperature, flow and weather, shows the official Ontario season status for each stretch (synced from the Ontario Fishing Regulations Summary twice a day), and suggests the technique and fly for the day. 7 days free, then $9.99 a month or $59.99 a year.

Key facts:
- Coverage: trout, steelhead and salmon rivers across Southern Ontario (Lake Ontario, Lake Erie, Georgian Bay and Lake Huron tributaries and inland trout water), plus rivers, creeks and, in winter, lakes that anglers scout within their own radius.
- Regulations come from the official Ontario Fishing Regulations Summary; always confirm the exact stretch before fishing.
- Exact fishing spots are never published.

## Salmon run
- [Ontario salmon run: where and when to see it](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/salmon-run/): run timing, viewing spots and what's legal, with a weekly run status.
- [Old Mill salmon run, Toronto](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/salmon-run/humber-river-old-mill-toronto/)
- [Port Hope salmon run and fish ladder](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/salmon-run/port-hope-ganaraska-river/)
- [Credit River salmon run, Mississauga](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/salmon-run/credit-river-mississauga/)
- [Bowmanville salmon run](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/salmon-run/bowmanville-creek/)

## Steelhead and trout
- [Ontario steelhead rivers](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/steelhead/): which stretches are open in fall, winter and spring, river by river.
- [River guides](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/rivers/): species, best months, official seasons and access for 26 river sections.
- [Fishing spots by town](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/fishing-spots/)

## Regulations
- [Ontario fishing regulations by zone](https://muddyyorkfishing.ca/regulations/): seasons and limits for all 20 Fisheries Management Zones, checked against ontario.ca twice a day.
